Real PowerPoint 16 / Windows 11 measurements of the double6 verification decks (generated by this repo's
`scripts/verify/cases.py`, MIT). Used by `tests/test_powerpoint_calibration.py` to keep the text-fit engine
calibrated: PowerPoint single spacing = 1.2 em, no spcBef on the first paragraph, level sizes 32/28pt, and a
saved `normAutofit fontScale` is NOT honoured on recompute.
